scope:
New flex shorthand compilation/resolution cost over prebuilt components.
Seven frozen release processes. Numeric flex cases visit all three assignments;
a pending shorthand group resolves once. Separate longhands are descriptive
controls; no before implementation of the accepted shorthand exists. Excludes
syntax construction, cascade, style/layout, GUI, GPU and site acceptance.

observations.method: Compile/drop mean over rounds; resolve mean with scratch and variable resolver retained; flex visits all three numeric assignments or resolves their shared pending group once, other cases visit the first. Pending resolution includes typed reparsing and assignment allocation, other variants are reference access controls. Retained batches hold 1000 independent declarations. Bytes exclude allocator metadata and original Syntax. Memory batch cases have independent scalar programs/one pending per declaration, so referenced heaps are unique.
observations.scope: Prebuilt component declaration compilation and isolated numeric or cached substitution resolution, no cascade/style/layout/painting/browser/Chrome evidence
